question: FTX Crypto Cup is associated with which of the following sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**** FTX Crypto Cup:**

__
 
• The world’s** FIRST bitcoin chess tournament**
 
• The **FTX Crypto Cup promises the tantalising first match-up between Magnus Carlsen and his new world title challenger.**
 
• Its an online chess tournament
 
• It attracts some of the world's top chess players, contributing to its global significance in the chess community.
